mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific regime conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in 60% or more of the months when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the months when UNRATE < 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates monetary policy easing coupled with strengthening supply conditions, which together compress equity discount rates and boost S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and INDPRO rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in 60% or more of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year > 3.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals that the labor market is strong enough to support economic activity without triggering a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, UNRATE decline does not lead to positive 5-day SPX returns in 60% or more of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and residential investment, which supports overall economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring specific regime conditions.
failure_condition: HOUST trend fails to predict positive 60-day returns in 60% or more of the months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector that may lead to supply chain disruptions and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in 60% or more of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates monetary policy easing amid rising inflation, which may trigger fears of a recession and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to produce negative 60-day returns in 60% or more of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0%), a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a potential recovery in consumer spending that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 QoQ < 1.0%, RSAFS rise does not lead to positive 5-day SPX returns in 60% or more of cases.
